CustomField.description: Conditionally Show Invoice Date Field on Operations PDF Copy
CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT( EOP_Order__c ) = "Yes"," *** EOP Invoice Date: " + TEXT( MONTH( Invoice_Date__c ) ) + "/" & TEXT( DAY( Invoice_Date__c ) ) + "/" + TEXT( YEAR( Invoice_Date__c ) ) ,"")
CustomField.label: PDF EOP Invoice Date
